pit_profile.why: Commodity exposure (Targa Resources Corp. FY2021 10-K): Our primary natural gas gathering and processing arrangements that expose us to commodity price risk are our percent-of-proceeds arrangements. Risk factor: 'Our cash flow is affected by supply and demand for natural gas, NGL products and crude oil and by natural gas, NGL, crude oil and condensate prices, and decreases in commodity prices and/or activity levels could adversely affect our results of operations and financial condition.' The Targa Resources Corp. FY2021 10-K does not call the business cyclical (the dividend policy's 'seasonal and cyclical factors' of the earlier 10-Ks no longer appears); no disruption theme in taxonomy_eras.json is live for a midstream natural gas company on this date (of the live themes, OFFSHORE is scoped to 'lower-cost offshore delivery (Indian IT services) takes share and price from Western consulting, systems integration and outsourcing', CLOUD to 'public cloud displaces on-premise hardware, storage, legacy databases and data-center outsourcing', ECOMMERCE to 'e-commerce (Amazon effect) displaces physical retail, malls, grocery, distribution', STREAMING to 'cord-cutting / streaming displaces linear TV networks and pay-TV bundles', ENERGY_TRANSITION to 'decarbonisation strands oil, gas and coal reserves and refining', EV to 'battery-electric vehicles displace ICE powertrains, auto parts suppliers and fuel retail', CRYPTO to 'crypto / DeFi disintermediates payments networks, banks, exchanges, remittance': none names midstream energy but ENERGY_TRANSITION, whose oil, gas and coal reserves and refining a gatherer and processor does not hold (the BKR reading: the Targa Resources Corp. FY2021 10-K names no reserves of Targa's, and its refinery services are NGL balancing for refiners, 'In our refinery services business, we typically provide NGL balancing services through contractual arrangements with refiners in several locations to purchase and/or market propane and to supply butanes.'; the Channelview Splitter is the subject of the terminated agreement's litigation (Targa Channelview, sold in October 2020): 'On December 26, 2018, Vitol Americas Corp. (“Vitol”) filed a lawsuit in the 80th District Court of Harris County (the “District Court”), Texas against Targa Channelview LLC, then a subsidiary of the Company (“Targa Channelview”), seeking recovery of $129.0 million in payments made to Targa Channelview, additional monetary damages, attorneys’ fees and costs.'); the 10-Ks' 'offshore' is the Gulf Coast and its waters, the Targa Resources Corp. FY2021 10-K does not name artificial intelligence, and no 10-K names e-commerce, streaming, electric vehicles or crypto), so the watch list is empty and these words stay here, with the greenhouse gas risk factor: 'Our and our customers’ operations are subject to a number of risks arising out of the threat of climate change that could result in increased operating costs, limit the areas in which oil and natural gas production may occur, and reduce demand for the products and services we provide.' (the PEP obesity rule)

BEAR.desc: EPS -55.1%/yr (worst year FY12-FY15, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +94.3%/yr (Q4 revenues + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY16 ex-FY17 ex-FY18 ex-FY19 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 median

BULL.desc: EPS +94.3%/yr (FY12-FY15 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +94.3%/yr (best 2-yr run FY12-FY15, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: TRGP (retrospective, 2022-04-01) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.04x (52.2% downside to Bear $37 / +1305.5% upside to Bull $1087) | Adj composite 2.95 vs market 1.00: gap +1.95 [UNDERVALUED] | -57% above the EPP floor $180 (35x FY22E $5.13) | Conservative 2-yr case: +1081.1% total (+540.5%/yr) | At 15.1x FY22E the 15% hurdle price $102 sits at or below the BASE case; Gathering and Processing +46.7% and Logistics and Marketing +6.7% operating margin in Q4 2021, forward revenues +111.5% (no FY22 revenue guide in numbers, Q4 2021 revenues as reported); no theme in the registry is live for a midstream natural gas company on this date; none has dated evidence.
